weather_report:
Subiaco dozes under a quiet, pre-dawn sky, the air cool and smelling faintly of wet pavement. Clouds hang low and unhurried, softening the streetlights and blurring edges, as if the town has been gently turned down to a murmur.

Closer to sunrise a light rain is likely to pass through, then ease into a day of broken cloud and shy sun. Expect intervals of brightness rather than a bold blue canopy; the light will be silver and changeable. UV is negligible now but will climb quickly after breakfast in this spring stretch, likely high by late morning even with the clouds, so carry sunglasses and a dab of sunscreen if you linger outdoors. Dress in easy layers with a light waterproof and comfortable shoes that don’t mind a sprinkle. It looks like a pleasant, tempered day once the showers move on—good for a quiet coffee by the window while the rain taps, then a mid-morning stroll to the shops or a lazy browse at the market when the light softens. If you’re staying in, open a window to the cool air and let the rooms breathe; if you’re heading out, time errands between passing showers and save a longer walk for when the sky breaks open in patches.
